Obtain Viet Nam map data

Source: R/vn-map.R
vn_map.Rd

Returns a simple-features boundary layer for the provincial-level administrative units of Viet Nam. The current layer contains the 34 units effective from 1 July 2025. A 63-unit layer is retained for data collected under the immediately preceding geography.

Usage

vn_map(
  geography = c("provinces", "communes", "provinces_63", "districts_63", "communes_63"),
  include = NULL,
  region = NULL,
  province = NULL,
  crs = vnmap_crs()
)

Arguments

geography

One of "provinces" (the 34 units effective from July 2025), "communes" (current commune-level units), "provinces_63" (the pre-July 2025 units), "districts_63" (the pre-July 2025 district-level units), or "communes_63" (the pre-July 2025 commune-level units). See Details for the optional lower-level layers.

include

Optional character vector of names, aliases, official two-digit codes, or ISO 3166-2 codes to retain. Vietnamese names may be supplied with or without diacritics.

region

Optional character vector of socio-economic region codes ("RRD", "NMM", "NCC", "CH", "SE", "MRD") or English region names used to retain whole regions. Units matching either include or region are kept. Available only for the provincial geographies.

province

Optional character vector of provincial-level identifiers (names, aliases, or codes) used to keep only the lower-level units that fall inside those provinces. Available for "communes", "districts_63", and "communes_63"; historical layers resolve against the 63-unit geography.

crs

Coordinate reference system understood by sf::st_transform().

Value

An sf object with one row per unit. Provincial layers carry code, iso, name_vi, name_en, type, and geometry; current units created by the 2025 reform have NA in iso where no code is bundled. The lower-level layers carry code, name_vi, name_en, province_code, province_en, and geometry.

Details

The bundled geometry is projected to EPSG:3405 by default. Pass a different EPSG code or an sf CRS object to crs when another projection is required. Filtering happens before transformation.

The current 34-unit layer is dissolved from the exact same current commune source described below, so parent and child boundaries share the same 25 July 2026 observed snapshot. Historical "provinces_63" geometry remains derived from geoBoundaries. All geometry is intended for statistical graphics, not surveying, navigation, or legal determinations.

The bundled "communes" layer contains the 3,321 current commune-level units in the 25 July 2026 catalogue snapshot. It carries validity, geography-vintage, source, and geometry-accuracy columns. Its boundaries are generalized to 100 metres for statistical graphics.

The optional "districts_63" (second-level) and "communes_63" (third-level) layers hold the district and commune units as they existed before the July 2025 reform, which abolished the district tier and merged communes. They are historical only, are not bundled by default because of their size, and are generated by data-raw/build_adm2.R and data-raw/build_adm3.R; vn_map() raises an informative error when the requested layer has not been built. The commune layer contains many thousands of units, so filtering with province (or include) is strongly recommended rather than drawing it nationwide.

This function requires the sf package. Name and code lookups (province_code(), province_info(), province_region()) work without it.

See also

plot_vnmap(), province_code(), province_info()

Examples

map <- vn_map()
nrow(map)
#> [1] 34
names(map)
#>  [1] "code"              "iso"               "name_vi"          
#>  [4] "name_en"           "type"              "geometry"         
#>  [7] "geography_vintage" "source_url"        "snapshot_date"    
#> [10] "observed_on"       "geometry_accuracy"

north <- vn_map(include = c("Ha Noi", "Bac Ninh"))
nrow(north)
#> [1] 2

delta <- vn_map(region = "MRD")
nrow(delta)
#> [1] 6

historical <- vn_map("provinces_63", crs = 4326)
sf::st_crs(historical)$input
#> [1] "EPSG:4326"

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Lower-level layers must be built first (see data-raw/build_adm3.R).
hanoi_communes <- vn_map("communes_63", province = "Ha Noi")
} # }
